verdict.rationale: Codegen docs explicitly describe triggering agents from CI/CD pipelines on build failure (codegen-docs-18), an agent endpoint that analyzes sandbox/setup logs to identify errors and suggest fixes (codegen-docs-39), and agent permissions to automatically create pull requests with code changes (codegen-docs-24, codegen-docs-32). Together these map directly to 'diagnose failed CI and propose a fix via PR.' Missing for 10: a single documented end-to-end example wiring CI-failure trigger -> log analysis -> auto PR creation, and independent/hands-on verification beyond vendor docs.
